description: Keyword search of the EveryAI directory, up to 50 results: use it to browse a category, list what exists for a topic, or find a tool by name. To choose a tool for a user's task, call recommend_tool instead (it applies constraints, explains each pick and ranks without regard to payment). Results carry the EveryAI page, website, category and a short description; ties go to listings marked "featured", which are paid placements.

q.description: A topic or a tool name. Leave empty to list the newest tools (featured first).

name: search_tools
title: Search AI tools
